<!-- Source page: Garage -->

[Garage](https://garagehq.deuxfleurs.fr) is an open-source, self-hostable S3 store, for geodistributed stores.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-garage).
